context: A teacher mentors a teen on cultural research
purpose: Teach: 病状/横綱/法王/君臨/演目/直訳/装い/床下

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、市民の病状、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on wartime civilian health conditions was genuinely impressive — the thoroughness you brought to it really stood out.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Steady eye contact. Slight pause before naming the specific topic, showing genuine recall. Voice lifts gently on the compliment itself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、横綱、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really wanted to do justice to the Edo period and the role of the yokozuna — that era deserved a deep, careful treatment.
lines.style: Sincere, almost formal gratitude. Speaks a bit slowly to emphasize her own investment in the work. Quiet pride underneath the politeness, not hidden but not performative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中世の、本気で、絶対、法王、絶対、政治、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled medieval papal politics — your perspective was genuinely sophisticated. You didn't just describe the period, you questioned it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. Leans back slightly, as if recalling details with care. Warm tone that says she's seen something in Sakura's thinking. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、王朝が、絶対、君臨、絶対、した時代、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes — I wanted to really understand how ancient dynasties claimed and held power. That required going beyond the surface, and I'm grateful the research let me do that.
lines.style: Composed, reflective. Speaks to the substance of her own work without overselling it. Slightly formal register — she respects what Asuka sees in her thinking. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統芸能の、本気で、絶対、演目、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of traditional performance arts was particularly engaging. You brought real insight to those performative choices.
lines.style: Genuine delight in her voice. Slight lean forward. The compliment feels personal, not generic. Warm but not gushing — this is a teacher who trusts Sakura to hear the sincerity without coating it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古典の、本気で、絶対、直訳、絶対、と、絶対、意訳、絶対、比較、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how literal translation and free interpretation of classical texts actually reveal different kinds of truth — comparing them felt essential to understanding the originals.
lines.style: Alert, engaged tone. She's meeting Asuka's energy. Speaks with quiet conviction about her methodology, not seeking approval but sharing her reasoning. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の貴族の、本気で、絶対、装い、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even your attention to detail on something like Heian nobility's clothing and ornamentation — you understood that aesthetics were never separate from meaning in that world.
lines.style: Contemplative, almost gentle. Longer phrases. This feels like genuine scholarly recognition. Voice has a reflective quality, as if Asuka is turning something over in her mind as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古民家の、本気で、絶対、床下、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes, and I realized the same principle applied to traditional houses — the under-floor structures weren't just practical. They were part of how people understood their relationship to their own space and seasons.
lines.style: Confident, building on the idea. Not rushed. Sakura is thinking aloud here, and it's clear she's genuinely learned something from her own research. Warm, almost illuminated by her own insight.
